scope: Three neutral-bend-length, angle-meaning and no-stretch-development courses with authored ideal geometry and primary/source interpretation. No Rust/fullFOLD/CAD/host/scene, calibrated physical bend, manufacturing trial, runnable lab or production change.

findings.finding: All bend allowances and k bounds are conditional authored circular neutral-layer geometry. k interval is deterministic sensitivity, not vendor calibration, probability interval or outside-dimension bend compensation.

Signed FOLD degree deviation and the stipulated planar included-angle convention remain distinct. All 35 cases translate only inspected range/sign/zero predicates; no parser/checker execution or whole IX acceptance is claimed.

Selected records preserve arbitrary other metadata. That does not establish physical k/radius consumption. ADR explicitly excludes bend-radius refusals and folding motion; no repository-wide absence inference was used.

Zero Gaussian curvature is local and does not supply a cut-free global one-to-one rectangular chart. The closed-cylinder seam and exact smooth regular no-stretch sphere obstruction are bounded ideal geometry, outside the pinned flat IX domain. Approximation, material deformation and manufacture are not ruled out by the sphere statement.

The inaccessible Autodesk support article body/images remain unread. Source test assertions are text evidence, not fresh results. No CAD command, host, checker, physical bend or fabrication was executed.
Stored full-circle chord ~2.45e-15 mm is ordinary floating evaluation residue; exact endpoint separation is zero. It does not contradict the seam or create a physical gap.
